purpose: Fixed E9 development screen of one physical-Pinball loss replacement against saved COSINE9

population.threshold_arithmetic: Cast reference to FP32 before strict greater-than comparisons, inherit frozen evaluator bin membership

quantiles.reported_means: Sum mean-over-32-node losses, divide by applicable rainy/strong/weak population count

screen.primary_rule: For each primary metric, control - candidate > 1e-10
screen.guardrail_lower_rule: For each lower guardrail, candidate - control <= 1e-10
screen.guardrail_higher_rule: For each higher guardrail, control - candidate <= 1e-10
screen.pass_rule: All primary and guardrail conditions pass, with complete matching population and finite metrics
screen.weak_guardrail_reference: COSINE9 value 0.08872231160181854; inherited E0-to-COSINE9 weak-log degradation 7.5945274341407965 percent remains a reported limitation

future_candidate_saved_statistics.granularity: One record per declared scene, fixed E9 evaluation only
future_candidate_saved_statistics.loss_arithmetic: FP64 sum of per-pixel mean-over-32-node pinball; physical sums retain mm/h and normalized-by-20 fields
future_candidate_saved_statistics.bin_convention: Lower exclusive, upper inclusive; null upper bound is positive infinity; inherit frozen FP32 reference threshold membership

point_readouts.classification_arithmetic: Both reference and prediction cast to FP32, strict greater-than threshold

future_candidate_saved_statistics.occurrence_ranking: Compute global occurrence AP/AUROC over complete pooled population with inherited frozen evaluator and R>0.1 label. Per-scene AP/AUROC must not be averaged to obtain global scores. Additive scene summaries do not suffice for pooled ranking or event-resampled AP. This contract does not add all-population prediction storage.

checks: Control source bytes and SHA256 match this contract
All 963 scene identities and original masks match inherited population
Population sums and all seven disjoint rainy-bin counts reconcile
Scene loss/error/confusion sums reconstruct candidate global reports within frozen arithmetic tolerance
All model outputs and metric values finite, quantile nodes strictly ordered
Every threshold TP+FP+FN+TN equals applicable valid count
validation.on_failure: Stop relevant comparison and diagnose; retain outputs and failed receipts

execution_scope.authorization: Requires separate exact scientific plan, code and budget approval before formal execution
